parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query.

parameters.name: Dealed
parameters.description:
The event status. Valid values:

- **y**: Handled.
- **n**: Unhandled.
- **a**: All.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: PortraitId
parameters.description: The ID of the attacker portrait.

parameters.name: RequestId
parameters.description: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues.

parameters.name: SrcIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the attack.
